mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a single month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000, signals a strengthening labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month AND PAYEMS increases > 200,000
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% in a single month signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
